info.description: Optional muted hero video with a required primary source, optional alternate codec, and poster overrides

primaryVideo.description: Primary hero video: MP4/WebM, 2400 × 1200 px (2:1) composition recommended. Keep the important action in the center safe area.

alternateVideo.description: Optional alternate video codec with the same duration and framing as primaryVideo.

mobilePosterImage.description: Optional mobile video poster: 1080 × 1350 px (4:5) recommended.
